summary.text: Leonard Spencer is a Democratic member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 45, elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biographical page, Spencer lives in Gotha, is a business executive, holds a B.S. in finance from Tuskegee University and an M.B.A. in finance from the University of Alabama, and was born in Jacksonville.
